funnel_test.note: alerts use the tier of each event's latest CDM; abstain = tier set > 1 or out-of-distribution

transition_matrix_2d_to_tca.definition: tier of the last CDM >= 2 d from observed risk and miss distance, to the tier of the final CDM

altitude_band.note: t_h_per of the latest CDM (>= 2 d for train); display column, not a model input

risk_vs_time.note: risk = log10 Pc of each CDM, floored at -30; 20 sampled train events per final tier (seed 42)

reliability_p_critical.source: out-of-fold Task B probabilities, 8,293 train events

critical_rate_by_f10.reading: intervals do not all overlap: some F10 buckets differ; this is association, not cause
critical_rate_by_f10.note: F10 of the last CDM >= 2 d; 'Critical' = final tier Critical
